column2: [intro]
I never learned to play guitar
My fingers fumble, it's quite bizarre
The drums are a mystery to me
My rhythms fail, you laugh in glee
I'm a funny singer without much flair
No instrument makes me a star, I swear
My songs are sad yet full of life
I try to make you laugh, cut through the strife
The flute drives me up the wall
Sometimes I blow loud, sometimes too small
The piano, oh! I only hit wrong notes
But it won't stop me from trying my notes
I'm a funny singer without much flair
No instrument makes me a star, I swear
My songs are sad yet full of life
I try to make you laugh, cut through the strife
[ solo ]
Forget the virtuosos with their mastery
Come have fun with me, I’ll make you see
For without instruments, I can assure
A unique show, funny and pure.
[outro]
